content:
发信人: Ivye (人心惟危 道心惟微), 信区: ChildEducation
标 题: 发个流水账
发信站: 水木社区 (Mon Jun 15 08:46:39 2026), 站内

写作老大难，能坐那儿磨一个小时“我不知道要写啥”… 今天终于算是一气呵成，我们看了也很夸张地夸奖 — 先鼓励着能写起来再说质量。求评论求改进意见（也并不敢太直接给娃提怕打击兴趣，放心里以后慢慢讲吧）

On the weekend I played monopoly with my mom, my dad and my brother. First everyone was getting land and no one could build houses. Then, my mom got a piece of land, and built houses. After that, my brother cried because he thought mom was winning and she was! (I don’t completely know why because mom built those houses fair and square, but okay!) Then, with the money she earned from those houses, she built more houses, but at the same time my dad also built houses. Next my dad gained enough money to build more houses because he skipped over mom’s houses and eventually they both built up to hotels. After that, dad needed to prepare lunch so my brother took his place. Then I stepped on my dad’s land so I gave him a lot of my land. (Well, actually my brother was there because dad needed to prepare lunch as told but still, dad got the land.) Finally my brother built more houses and forced mom to sell her houses and my dad won. I didn’t win but I still had lots of fun.
